title: Lost Communication With Door Switch "C"
plain: Other computers in the car have stopped hearing from the door switch module "C". It runs a comfort or convenience feature.
symptoms: The feature that module controls may not work
Other modules may set related codes

causes.name: The door switch module "C" lost power or ground (blown fuse or bad ground)
Damaged, corroded or loose network wiring or connector
Weak battery or low system voltage
Failed door switch module "C"
Another module shorting out the network

checks: Test the battery and charging voltage first
Check the fuses, power and ground for the door switch module "C"
See which modules answer a scan tool to narrow down the break
Inspect network wiring and connectors near the module
fix: Restore power, ground or wiring to the door switch module "C"; replace the module only after those test good.
